Lint a recipe for common authoring mistakes (pure client-side)

Source: R/recipe.R
recipe_lint.Rd

Walks an omop_recipe and returns a tidy report of problems without contacting any server. The first and most important check is whether the recipe even compiles: recipe_to_plan is run inside tryCatch and any compile error becomes the no_compile lint. Remaining rules inspect outputs, variables, and population filters for structural and disclosure-safety issues that would otherwise surface only at execution time on the server.

Usage

recipe_lint(recipe)

Arguments

recipe

An omop_recipe object, or NULL.

Value

A data.frame with columns severity, code, message, locus (zero rows if the recipe is clean).

Details

Severities are "ERROR" (will fail), "WARNING" (likely rejected or wrong), and "INFO" (advisory). Rules:

no_compile (ERROR)

recipe_to_plan() throws.

empty_output (ERROR)

an output resolves to zero variables.

dup_output (ERROR)

duplicate output names.

concept_zero (ERROR)

a non-derived variable has an unmapped concept_id (0 or NA).

concept_unnamed (WARNING)

concept_id present but concept_name missing.

time_since_spec (ERROR)

a time_since variable lacks a valid fixed ISO derived$reference_date or derived$unit.

age_no_index (WARNING)

format = "age" with index reference but the base population has neither a cohort nor a date filter.

highcard_factor (WARNING)

a raw _concept_id column, or a categorical format on a high-cardinality domain.

window_inverted (WARNING)

a variable time_window with start > end.

long_split (INFO)

a "long" output spanning > 1 table.

no_value_source (INFO)

an aggregate format with no value_source.

tar_default, censoring_default, age_group_default, coverage, collapse, representation, missing_skip (INFO)

a default the recipe relies on, stated (e.g. "follow-up ends 730 days after index").

quasi_identifier (INFO)

a permitted birth component, age, age band, birth-year band or date column, one row per variable; final publication support and the absolute-date policy still apply. Aggregate admission is unchanged.

measurement_pair (INFO)

has_measurement / missing_measurement are not complements.

parent_inheritance (INFO)

a parent_id now restricts the child population.

language_2_only (INFO)

a recipe of 2.10.1 constructors whose shape 2.10.3 newly permits (e.g. a NOT group) has no v1 plan and runs as its language-2 plan on dsOMOP 2.10.3 servers only.

The lint has no mirror of server disclosure gates (no width floors, no mandatory bins): from 2.10.3 the server's final publication rule is the only release criterion on assign paths. Edge cases: a NULL recipe returns a single empty_recipe info row; a recipe with no outputs adds a no_output warning.

See also

recipe_to_plan, recipe_validate

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
recipe <- omop_recipe(outputs = omop_output(type = "wide"))
recipe_lint(recipe)
} # }
